cities.name: Mysuru
cities.tagline: The City of Palaces — Chamundi Devi gopurams, the royal darbar hall, Devaraja markets, silk, coffee and lakeside stays.

cities.name: Mangaluru
cities.tagline: Mangaluru's coastal markets, St. Aloysius and Kadri Manjunatha temples, Panambur beach and the port's busy trade.

cities.name: Hubballi

cities.name: Ballari

cities.tagline: Ballari's cotton trade, Rukmini Kalika temple, rock-cut cave heritage and Hoysala-era Belur nearby.

cities.name: Tumakuru
cities.tagline: Tumakuru — the mango city's riverside markets, dairy heartland and a growing retail and services economy.

cities.name: Davanagere

cities.tagline: Davanagere — a growing commercial hub on the Bengaluru–Mangaluru highway with strong retail and agricultural trade.

cities.name: Hassan
cities.tagline: Hassan — Hoysala capital with lakeside retail, restaurants, daily services and heritage stays.
